feature: Shared KMP data-layer-only local-first brew-log foundation
requirements: Research and decide local read-model shape before implementation.
Support offline brew-log creation when no cached beans exist by creating an optimistic local bean ref with a stable client-generated bean id.
Support reuse of pending optimistic beans already used in brew logs via stable bean_client_id / client-generated bean id.
Persist local brew_log row and sync_outbox intent atomically.
Implement outbox coalescing for pending_create update/delete and blocked_error edit re-arm where in scope.
Use authenticated profile id, not generic user id, for brew-log ownership semantics.
Expose local SQLDelight reads/projections from the data layer.
Keep generated API DTOs at the network boundary.
constraints: Data layer only; no UI integration.
No server endpoints or additional API contract changes beyond consuming the pinned api-spec-v0.1.4 contract update.
No iOS SQLCipher wiring in this run; document as follow-up production gate.
No standalone offline bean/recipe CRUD UI or general bean-management flows in v1; optimistic bean creation is only in scope as a brew-log dependency.
High-risk changes require architecture and final approval breakpoints.
